title: Christian Love
definition: Christian Love is the self-giving, truth-shaped, Christlike love that God commands and produces in His people.
summary: Christian Love is Spirit-formed affection and action that seeks another's good according to the character of Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ loved His people first and commands them to love one another as He has loved them.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christian love is self-giving love shaped by the character and command of Christ. Scripture defines love not merely as feeling warmth toward people, but as seeking their good according to truth.

This love is patient, truthful, sacrificial, forgiving, and active. It does not rejoice in sin, but it moves toward people with grace and courage.

Jesus loved first and loved at the cost of His own life. Believers learn love by looking at Him before looking at their own emotions.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Love is often redefined as approval, niceness, attraction, or convenience. Christian love protects truth while refusing coldness and shows the world what disciples of Jesus look like.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice love where it costs something. Speak truth gently, forgive as Christ forgave you, serve people who cannot repay you, and ask God to make your love more cross-shaped than comfort-shaped.
